title: Zorg v1 MVP Implementation Plan
Zorg Epic 1 Foundations
Phase 1: Shared Specification And Fixtures
description: Establish the shared .z syntax, semantic model, query/LSP/capture/fix docs, canonical fixtures, and README contract in ../zorg.

title: Phase 2: Rust Workspace Foundation
description: Create the executable Rust workspace skeleton, crate boundaries, validation docs, and smoke tests in ../zorg after Phase 1 lands.

title: Phase 3: Tree-Sitter Foundation
description: Create the standard Tree-sitter repository skeleton, minimal executable grammar, corpus tests, queries, metadata, and README in ../zorg-treesitter after Phase 1 lands.

title: Phase 4: Neovim Plugin Foundation
description: Create the minimal Neovim plugin skeleton, .z filetype detection, setup/LSP/Tree-sitter/command stubs, help docs, README, and smoke validation in ../zorg-nvim after Phase 1 lands.

title: Phase 5: Cross-Repo Validation And Handoff
description: Validate contract alignment across ../zorg, ../zorg-treesitter, and ../zorg-nvim, add cross-repo docs, run available validation, and leave handoff notes after Phases 1-4 complete.

title: Zorg Epic 2 Tree-Sitter Grammar And Highlighting
Phase 1: Grammar Architecture And Corpus Contract
description: Define Epic 2 grammar scope, public node names, no-legacy policy, and seed corpus coverage before structural implementation.
notes: Implemented grammar architecture and corpus contract in ../zorg-treesitter at commit 7c50ca2: documented Epic 2 scope, public node names, no-legacy policy, semantic boundaries, generated-artifact policy, and seeded query/template/legacy corpus coverage. Validation: npm run generate; npm test.

title: Phase 2: Structural Block Grammar
description: Replace flat tokens with structured file-header, zettel block, paragraph, blank-line, comment-scope, and fenced-code parsing.
notes: Implemented structural block grammar in ../zorg-treesitter at commit cea2559: file_header open/body/close nodes, zettel_item/opening blocks, paragraphs, blank_line nodes, fenced_code_block with fence_start/fence_end/info/content, corpus updates, and highlight query updates. Validation: npm run generate; npm test.

title: Phase 3: Zettel Opening Syntax And Inline Primitives
description: Add precise v1 syntax nodes for IDs, links, tags, properties, todo markers, and opening text across headers, openings, paragraphs, and adjacent text.

title: Phase 4: Query, Template, And Fenced-Code Handling
description: Ensure query/template zettel parse as ordinary .z syntax while preserving fenced-code info, raw body, and injection-ready structure.
notes: Implemented query/template fenced-code handling in ../zorg-treesitter at commit 518bf1b: code_fence_body raw body node, swog and zorg-template fixture coverage, ambiguous query syntax, ordinary rust fence with backticks, and grammar docs. Validation: npm run generate; npm test.

title: Phase 5: Editor Query Pack
description: Update highlights, folds, injections, locals strategy, and highlight smoke documentation against the finalized Epic 2 node names.
notes: Implemented editor query pack in ../zorg-treesitter at commit 190cb0c: highlights for IDs, links, tags, properties, todos, headers, list markers, fences, and info strings; folds for headers, zettel items, and fenced blocks; injections using fenced info_string languages for swog, zorg-template, and ordinary languages; locals strategy for local_id declarations scoped to zettel items; README smoke command and test/highlight/smoke.z fixture. Validation: npm run generate; npm test; npx tree-sitter highlight test/highlight/smoke.z; npx tree-sitter query for highlights/folds/injections/locals.

title: Phase 6: Integration Hardening And Handoff
description: Audit final node names and downstream expectations, settle generated-artifact policy, run parser/query validation, and prepare Epic 3 and Epic 8 handoff.
notes: Completed integration hardening in ../zorg-treesitter at commit 0189df1: audited public nodes against generated node-types and shared Zorg docs/fixtures, documented the final generated-artifact policy keeping src/ ignored with local generation required, added Rust and Neovim handoff expectations, and documented parser/query validation commands. Validation: npm run generate; npm test; npx tree-sitter highlight test/highlight/smoke.z; npx tree-sitter query for highlights/folds/injections/locals; npx tree-sitter parse ../zorg/fixtures/corpus/*.z ../zorg/fixtures/corpus/dir/*.z with no ERROR or MISSING output.

title: Epic 3: Rust Parse and Semantic Model
Phase 3.1: Core Semantic Model
description: Replace foundation-only zorg-core types with the complete typed model needed by parser, store, query, fix, capture, and LSP consumers.

title: Phase 3.2: Tree-sitter Binding and Parse Tree Boundary
description: Connect zorg-parse to the ../zorg-treesitter grammar and expose a real syntax parse boundary without completing all semantic lowering.

title: Phase 3.4: Semantic Validation
description: Add strict semantic validation over parsed documents and corpora, including duplicate IDs, malformed values, local ID context checks, and legacy-looking input diagnostics.

title: Phase 3.5: ID and Link Resolution
description: Resolve Zorg links and local IDs into canonical IDs, attach unresolved diagnostics, and finalize Epic 3 behavior for downstream store, query, LSP, fix, and capture work.

title: Phase 3.3: AST-to-Model Lowering and zorg parse
description: Lower Tree-sitter syntax into the typed zorg-core model and expose a stable CLI JSON dump for fixtures and downstream agents.

title: Zorg Epic 4: SQLite Store and Incremental Indexing
Phase 4.1: Store API, Path Policy, and SQLite Migrations
description: Replace the placeholder store with a real SQLite boundary and deterministic schema foundation.

title: Phase 4.2: Corpus Discovery and CLI Database Command Skeleton
description: Make the store discover canonical source files and expose database commands before full indexing.

title: Phase 4.3: Full Snapshot Indexing
description: Populate the SQLite store from parsed semantic documents through a clean full-reindex path.

title: Phase 4.4: Incremental Reindex, Hashing, and Deletion Handling
description: Make repeated indexing practical by skipping unchanged files and cleaning stale rows.

title: Phase 4.5: Tag Inheritance and Graph Materialization
description: Complete semantic graph requirements by materializing effective tags and path/parent ancestry relationships.

title: Zorg Epic 5: SWOG Query MVP
Phase 5.1: Query Contract, AST, and Parser
description: Define SWOG MVP syntax, AST, parser diagnostics, unsupported-feature errors, parser tests, and query docs.

title: Phase 5.2: Query Semantics, Normalization, and Store Adapter
description: Normalize parsed filters, define query semantics, introduce the query-facing store adapter, and test comparison behavior.

title: Phase 5.3: SQLite-Backed Planner and Evaluator
description: Evaluate normalized SWOG filters against the indexed SQLite store with deterministic ordering and integration coverage.

title: Phase 5.4: LIST Result Model and Renderer
description: Build structured query results and stable LIST rendering with golden tests and documentation updates.

title: Phase 5.5: Inline zorg query CLI
description: Expose inline SWOG LIST queries through zorg query with root/database handling, stdout rendering, and CLI tests.

title: Phase 5.6: Query Zettel Discovery and Execution
description: Execute ordinary #z/query zettel definitions by ID, including extraction, ambiguity handling, CLI syntax, and tests.

title: Phase 5.7: End-to-End Hardening, Docs, and Scope Guardrails
description: Harden the complete query path, align docs and tests, add guardrails for deferred features, and run final verification.
